name: operis-finance
description: Explain manufacturing financial results using the customer's own exports or explicitly configured read-only MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Explain financial changes from your ERP
interface.longDescription: Prepare source-backed margin, cash-exposure and management reviews from your own data. No shared customer connection is included. Live access requires a separately configured and authenticated customer MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Explain the change in gross margin between these two periods using my company's financial exports.
Review our receivables, payables and open purchasing commitments using the files I provide.
Prepare a concise management finance briefing with reconciled totals and source references.
